title.en: the sunday flea market at monastiraki, early.

line.en: the sunday market fills the streets round monastiraki station from about 9. go early: after 11 it is packed, and bargaining is expected.
line.de: der sonntagsmarkt füllt die straßen rund um die metrostation monastiraki ab etwa 9 uhr. früh kommen: nach 11 uhr ist es voll, und handeln gehört dazu.
line.tr: pazar pazarı saat 9 civarında monastiraki metro istasyonunun çevresini doldurur. erken gelin: 11'den sonra sokaklar kalabalık olur ve pazarlık beklenir.

sparks.why: Sunday flea market at Monastiraki, peak roughly 9am to 1pm and Sunday its busiest day, per the athenstourism.org and athensguide.com guides; a weekly market, not a dated announcement for 22.11.26.
